captions.detailed: A compact 8x25 porro-prism binocular with a dark, matte-black finish. It features two symmetrical, angled optical barrels connected by a central hinge mechanism. The central bridge supports a focus wheel, and the barrels terminate in cylindrical eyepieces and objective lenses. The barrels can rotate relative to each other along the central hinge axis via a revolute joint, and the focus wheel rotates independently around the same central axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact 8x25 porro-prism binocular with symmetrical left and right barrels. The assembly must include a central hinge joint and a focus wheel, with revolute articulations allowing the barrels and the central focus wheel to rotate about the main longitudinal axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject consisting of several parts: a central hinge, a focus wheel, and left and right optical barrels. The barrels are created with angled visual geometry to mimic the classic offset porro-prism shape, terminated with cylindrical eyepieces and objectives. Revolute articulations are defined along the Z-axis to connect the left and right barrels to the central hinge, and another revolute joint is used to mount the focus wheel to the central hinge.
